_comment: Maps MITRE CWE IDs to the cryptographic-weakness categories used as PQC-readiness proxies. A CWE not listed here is not counted as cryptographic. Category membership is the authors' judgment (docs/VERIFY_CHECKLIST.md). 'no_encryption' is reported separately: a product with no cryptography has nothing to migrate and must first adopt cryptography at all.
agility_debt_why: Products whose advisories cite these weaknesses already handle cryptography in a way that is fixed in firmware, unauthenticated, or weakly implemented. A PQC migration replaces algorithms and keys, so each of these is a direct obstacle to it.
